description.zh: 数据库代理连接地址ID。支持集群地址与自定义地址的查询，不支持主地址的查询。不传则默认查询集群地址。
数据库实例节点ID。用于查询Proxy在不同DB节点上的指标，支持指标为PolarProxy\_DBConns、PolarProxy\_DBQps、PolarProxy\_DBActionOps。
description.en: The ID of the node in the cluster. This parameter can be used to query the performance metrics of PolarProxy on different nodes. The following metrics are supported: PolarProxy\_DBConns, PolarProxy\_DBQps, and PolarProxy\_DBActionOps.

description.zh: 查询结束时间。格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ`（UTC时间）。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC.
The interval at which performance data is collected. Valid values: 5, 30, 60, 600, 1800, 3600, 86400, in seconds.

description.zh: 查询的性能指标，多个值间用英文逗号（,）分隔，详细参数请参见[性能参数表](~~141787~~)。
description.en: The performance metrics that you want to query. Separate multiple indicators with commas (,). For more information, see [Performance parameters](~~141787~~).

description.zh: 查询开始时间。格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ`（UTC时间）。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

description.zh: 特殊指标，目前仅支持tair（PolarTair架构）。
description.en: Special metric. Set the value to tair, which indicates the PolarTair architecture.

title.zh: 查询PolarDB代理层（PolarProxy）的性能数据

descriptions.zh: > 该接口仅适用于PolarDB MySQL版。
descriptions.en: > This operation is applicable only to PolarDB for MySQL clusters.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb describe-db-proxy-performance --db-cluster-id pc-0000000000000000 --db-endpoint-id pe-0000000000000000 --interval 60 --type tair --key PolarProxy_CpuUsage --start-time 2020-09-23T01:01Z --end-time 2020-09-24T02:08Z --db-node-id pi-0000000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb DescribeDBProxyPerformance --region cn-hangzhou --Type tair --DBEndpointId 'pe-0000000000000000' --EndTime '2020-09-24T02:08Z' --DBClusterId 'pc-0000000000000000' --StartTime '2020-09-23T01:01Z' --DBNodeId 'pi-0000000000000000' --Key PolarProxy_CpuUsage --Interval 60
